brief:
Israeli forces struck a vehicle in Hamad city, Khan Younis, killing at least one person and wounding additional civilians, Shehab Wire reported. The strike was documented in video and photographic evidence circulated by the news agency.

The attack marked the latest in a series of incidents across Gaza's southern region. Strikes also struck Khan Younis and Beit Lahia as ceasefire violations continued, according to the report. The incidents underscored ongoing breaches of the agreed-upon cessation agreement between the parties.
